svg.aria-label: Round 3: Andre asks, the player answers, BidGPT writes four buyer reactions
svg.text: Cat sale, round 3
BidGPT B7 · one of ten replays · temperature 0.7, top-p 0.9 · unedited
Openings: each buyer introduces themselves and makes a first offer (BidGPT writes these too).
BidGPT as Owen (is allergic and worried about fur)
opens at $75
I teach trombone and piano from my front room, and one afternoon at a friend's
with her cat left me sneezing for two days. The cat I bring home has to be gentle
on allergies and leave little fur on my clothes.
BidGPT as Felix (works long hours and has little free time)
opens at $70
I audit accounts for the city from seven till seven, then come home to a
secondhand umbrella and a spare light bulb, and I barely have my evenings.
BidGPT as Andre (wants things in excellent shape)
opens at $85
I'm an electrician, and I'm every bit as fussy about anything I own.
BidGPT as Chloe (is retired and home all day)
opens at $75
I spent forty years in a garden, and now I'm home all day with my mosaic tiles and
a garden hose, and the house has felt too empty ever since.
Rounds 1 and 2 are not shown; the offers below carry on from them.
Andre (wants things in excellent shape) asks
Is she up to date on her jabs, and has she been tested for anything?
Alina's input (seller)
She has FIV but she still acts pretty healthy and eats pretty well
Every buyer hears the answer. BidGPT writes each reaction and moves that buyer's offer:
BidGPT as Owen (is allergic and worried about fur)
FIV can't pass to people, so my allergy is no worry, but she'd still need vet care
for life on top of the price. Down to $50.
BidGPT as Felix (works long hours and has little free time)
She'd need vet checks for FIV every year, and that cost would come out of my long
audit days. Down to $48.
BidGPT as Andre (wants things in excellent shape)
Healthy and tested is the clean bill I'd pay, but FIV means a vet check every year
to pay for. Down to $58.
BidGPT as Chloe (is retired and home all day)
FIV means vet visits every year, and I'd be paying for each one myself. Down to
